provenance.designs: reconstructed by importing the bundle scripts/common.py and scripts/ladder_correlations.py and re-running their own basis builders on the bundle corpora; recomputed V2 checked against recorded V2

disclaimer: Classification fits are MEASUREMENTS, not theorems. The catastrophe labels are read off least-squares local normal forms of a finite sampled ray map and are contingent on the fit window, the Noll j<=11 truncation and the numerical-rank tolerance. Nothing here is elevated to an identity-type claim.

method.ray_map: disk (u,v) -> stereographic lift -> basis evaluation -> projection on the top-2 right singular subspace of the sampled design
method.zernike: Noll j<=11 least squares on the sampled disk points, coefficients normalized to unit 2-norm per component
method.normal_form: degree<=4 bivariate polynomial fit of the singular component in Jacobian-kernel-aligned local coordinates on a 25x25 grid
method.gap_E: one-column perturbations: in-family add, in-family replace, generic add, generic replace, plus an eps sweep of one additively perturbed column

in_family_add.what: PC3 (next column of the same PCA family)

generic_add.what: append one generic seeded N(0,1) column

generic_replace.what: replace last column with a generic seeded N(0,1) column

eps_sweep.what: one column additively perturbed by eps*scale*seeded noise

catastrophe.note: Jacobian determinant is bounded away from zero on every illuminated sample point: the ray map has no singular locus. The V2=1.0000 is a dimension identity of the basis (D=2), not a caustic of the map.

in_family_add.what: one more phase-offset column of the same lobe family

in_family_replace.what: column 0 replaced by another phase offset (in-family)

generic_add.what: append one generic seeded N(0,1) column

generic_replace.what: replace last column with a generic seeded N(0,1) column

eps_sweep.what: one column additively perturbed by eps*scale*seeded noise

catastrophe.note: degree-4 local normal form of the singular component of the ray map, in coordinates aligned with the Jacobian kernel; Whitney criterion: quadratic-in-kernel term dominant -> fold, vanishing quadratic with cubic dominant -> cusp; corank 2 -> umbilic by cubic discriminant sign.
